limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
The rule judges the value syntax; it cannot prove that a browser discarded the header.
purpose: HSTS carries an unparsable max-age value, so browsers discard the header and the origin has no HSTS policy.

groundTruth.rationale: A max-age directive whose value is not an unsigned integer makes the header invalid; the user agent ignores it entirely, leaving the origin without the upgrade protection the operator intended.
